title: READFIELD MAP E1 · LINE ↔ DATADISC
hypothesis: Stable angular source position may improve interruption recovery and positional memory relative to an information-matched linear minimap.
baseline: LINE: normalized source position rendered linearly.
mutation: DISC: the same unit ticks and section boundaries rendered on one clockwise ring. No spiral, hierarchy, compound glyph payload, AI summary, semantic weighting, or extra status channel.

donor.observed_mechanism: 2019 donor places 150 compound glyph discs along a two-revolution Archimedean spiral and carries per-disc status channels; E1 intentionally does not copy those additional channels.

thresholds.transfer: DISC median RT >=15% faster AND median positional error >=20% lower
thresholds.hold_modify: RT gain 5–15% or mixed speed/error result
thresholds.no_transfer: absolute RT gain <5% AND positional-error gain <10%
thresholds.hard_reject: DISC >10% slower AND no >=15% positional-error benefit

return_law: A completed trial emits local evidence only. Success transfers one mechanism into READFIELD; failure parks/composts the experiment. E1 does not acquire source/cursor authority.
non_claims: pilot/local evidence is not population-level confirmation
the 2019 DataDisc semantics are not imported into READFIELD
